subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Should the canonical bounded platform-opener lifecycle live in shared `open-path` for both `config.openFile` and `sessions.files.reveal`, or remain config-specific with a separate session-reveal solution?
rationale: Both open PRs solve the same foreground-opener hang but assign responsibility to different modules; source-level correctness does not establish which ownership boundary the project wants to preserve.

options.title: Use the shared `open-path` owner
options.body: Land a rebased version of this PR if maintainers want one lifecycle contract shared by both existing gateway callers.

options.title: Keep config-specific ownership
options.body: Prefer the config-focused design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109126 and require a separate bounded session-reveal solution before closing this PR.

options.title: Request a consolidated replacement
options.body: Ask for one narrowly rebased PR that adopts the chosen owner explicitly and retires the duplicate implementation path.

recommendation.title: Use the shared `open-path` owner
recommendation.body: Land a rebased version of this PR if maintainers want one lifecycle contract shared by both existing gateway callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this person and the remaining blocker is an ownership decision, not a mechanical code repair.
